item.title: News/Media Alliance Files Amicus Brief in Emmerich Newspapers v. Particle Media
item.description: On December 22, the News/Media Alliance along with other news associations filed an amicus brief in the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit in support of the appellant in Emmerich Newspapers v. Particle Media (dba Newsbreak).

item.title: News/Media Alliance Submits Comments to FTC on Petition to Renew Click to Cancel Rule
item.description: The Alliance sent comments to the Federal Trade Commission’s request for public comment regarding a joint petition it received from the Consumer Federation of America and the American Economic Liberties Project.

item.title: News/Media Alliance Joins Amicus Brief in The New York Times Co. (NYT) v. Department of Defense
item.description: The brief highlights the importance of Pentagon journalism and examples of public interest news reporting on military and national security issues.

item.title: News/Media Alliance Meets with Postmaster General & Postal Regulatory Commission
item.description: We discussed how rate increases are impacting our members, working together collaboratively, service, and more.

item.title: News/Media Alliance Statement on Google AI Mode Opt-Out Announcement: “Cautiously Optimistic”
item.description: The News/Media Alliance today released a statement in response to Google's announcement that it would begin exploring options for content producers to opt out of their content being used in its search-related generative AI products, like AI Overviews or AI mode.

item.title: News/Media Alliance Files Comments with USTR, Expressing Concerns over TDM Exceptions
item.description: The Alliance’s comments focused on proposals for expanded text and data mining (TDM) exceptions around the world that undermine American IP and creative industries. In particular, the comments discussed developments in Hong Kong, South Korea, Singapore, and Vietnam.

item.title: Drone Coalition Sends Letter to FAA on Flight Restrictions
item.description: The News Media Drone Coalition, which NMA is a part of, sent a letter to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) on January 28 urging the FAA to immediately lift the Temporary Flight Restriction (TFR) for all drones “in proximity to select location and mobile assets nationwide."
